title: 100-Mode Grid with Deep 16-Layer Skip-Free MLP
intuition: Replaces the shallow generator on `grid100` with a deep 16-layer skip-free MLP to isolate Law 4.2 (Pathology-Driven Spectral Conditioning): ordinary optimizers suffer exponential singular-value collapse across 16 layers.
failure_mode: Without spectral equilibration (e.g., polar/Newton-Schulz conditioning), gradients vanish or explode through 16 skip-free linear layers and the generator collapses onto a handful of modes.
protocol_notes: Tier-4 held benchmark and Four Laws Adherence Law 4 anchor.
